brief:
A funeral was held Saturday in Gaza for approximately 100 Palestinians whose bodies were recovered from rubble left by Israeli attacks, according to Middle East Eye. The ceremony brought together families and community members to mourn those killed in the destruction of residential areas across the territory.

The recovered bodies were pulled from the wreckage of homes destroyed during the military operations. The mass funeral reflected the scale of casualties and destruction that has marked the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
